categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: capsules, raw materials, and cosmetics. The capsule segment includes manufacturing hard capsules and contract manufacturing of soft capsule pharmaceuticals and health functional foods. The raw materials segment produces and sells gelatin and collagen products, key ingredients for capsules. The cosmetics segment undertakes OEM/ODM production of basic cosmetic products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies for hard and soft capsules, including full-process contract manufacturing for pharmaceuticals and health functional foods. It produces gelatin and collagen as raw materials sourced from domestic and international suppliers. The company also operates smart factories to enhance production efficiency and cost competitiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical companies, food companies, and cosmetics companies primarily in South Korea. The company also exports capsules, gelatin, and related products globally. The health functional food and pharmaceutical markets are growing due to aging populations and increased health awareness.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are centered in South Korea with production facilities in Cheongju and Busan. The company has overseas subsidiaries and production plants in the United States, Vietnam, Japan, and Europe, supporting global sales and manufacturing. Export markets include various countries worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream supply chain, manufacturing capsules and health functional foods, producing raw materials like gelatin, and providing OEM/ODM services for cosmetics. It supplies capsules and raw materials to pharmaceutical, food, and cosmetics manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maximizing functional efficacy in vivo, ensuring product safety, developing scientifically advanced and customized new products, and expanding health functional food and pharmaceutical offerings. The company invests in R&D with a dedicated research institute focusing on marine collagen, omega-3 jelly products, and functional ingredient certifications. It also emphasizes smart factory operations for cost and quality improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of hard capsules, soft capsule pharmaceuticals, health functional foods, gelatin raw materials, and cosmetics. The company also earns income from contract manufacturing (OEM/ODM) services. Domestic sales are on credit or prepaid terms, while exports use various payment methods including letters of credit and cash in advance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a dominant domestic market position with approximately 95% market share in hard capsules and ranks third globally with about 6-7% market share. It is recognized as the sole specialized hard capsule manufacturer in South Korea and a leading health functional food and pharmaceutical contract manufacturer. Competitors are not explicitly named but the company maintains a strong competitive edge through quality and production capacity.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported total assets of approximately 993.7 billion KRW and total sales of about 594.6 billion KRW, with a slight decline in sales and profitability compared to the previous year due to global economic challenges. The company has stable credit ratings (A- with stable outlook) and maintains a balanced capital structure with a debt ratio of 108.3%. It is classified as a mid-sized enterprise with steady growth prospects supported by overseas production expansions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior product quality, timely delivery, and excellent customer service to achieve customer satisfaction. It differentiates itself through exclusive domestic market dominance in hard capsules, advanced manufacturing capabilities for diverse pharmaceutical and health functional food formulations, and integrated production of raw materials like gelatin. The smart factory and R&D innovations further enhance its competitive advantage.
